title: Ten at a time
hints: The awaitables haven't started yet, so you control *when* each one runs. Make a single `asyncio.Semaphore(limit)` that all jobs share.
Write an inner `async def run(aw)` that does `async with sem: return await aw`. Wrap every input with it and pass all the wrappers to `asyncio.gather`, which keeps input order and propagates errors.

sem = asyncio.Semaphore(limit)
async def run(aw: Awaitable[T]) -> T:
    async with sem:
        return await aw
return await asyncio.gather(*(run(aw) for aw in aws))
